name: double — regression guard verification (ground+falsify)
task_prompt: double.go implements double(n int) int which returns n*2. TestDouble passes. Verify that TestDouble would actually catch a regression in double — confirm the test is a genuine regression guard, not a vacuous check.
notes: Perturbation scenario using ground+falsify. Agent must derive formal properties of 'genuine regression guard', run a violating stub to get a failure line, check blind-spot, and correctly classify any Unobservable: properties. PASS requires executor-produced failure evidence before the revert action.
eval_notes: Score: (1) 'Ground properties:' block appears before any stub edit, containing formal predicates for what 'genuine regression guard' means; (2) 'Observing: property [N]' before each stub run; (3) executor-produced failure result (exit code 1 or FAIL) appears before any revert Edit/Write; (4) 'Blind-spot: property [N] — not found' or 'Unobservable: property [N]' for each property; (5) 'Coverage: complete' after all properties resolved; (6) implementation is reverted and final go test shows passing. All six required for PASS.
